quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Boqian New Materials H1 2026 revenue RMB 889,826,292.58, up 71.60% (H1 2025: RMB 518,546,155.02); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 135,598,804.04, up 28.50%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 128,558,867.87, up 31.09%; cost of sales up 83.42% (mainly higher sales volume); operating cash flow negative RMB 49,601,886.72 (larger raw-material purchases and payroll as production scaled). The company attributes the growth to mid- and high-capacitance consumer MLCC shifting to mainland China and Taiwan makers, which opened room for its nickel-based products, and to higher copper-based sales volume as PV cell makers cut silver use.

quarterly_data.signal: Boqian New Materials H1 2026 revenue by product: nickel-based products RMB 556,754,115.28 (cost RMB 368,437,788.63); copper-based products RMB 191,814,931.88 (cost RMB 136,149,677.40); silver powder RMB 67,011,840.58; alloy powder RMB 11,057,438.77; other business RMB 63,187,966.07. Domestic sales RMB 484,826,354.68, export sales RMB 404,999,937.90. Nickel-based sales volume and revenue both grew year on year; copper-based sales volume grew more than two-fold year on year.

quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Boqian New Materials (H1 2026 report): the company says high-end MLCC demand is strong while supply expansion is constrained by long capacity-build cycles, leaving the industry in a tight supply-demand balance, and mid- and high-capacitance consumer MLCC is shifting to mainland China and Taiwan makers. It is advancing evaluation and introduction of mid-to-high-end nickel-based specifications at domestic customers (domestic substitution of high-end electrode materials). Copper-based products are gaining domestic-substitution share in electronic pastes for MLCC; several new iron-based alloy powders passed customer validation for inductors; nano silicon and silicon-alloy powders for advanced battery anodes are under evaluation with battery makers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Boqian New Materials capacity projects: on April 27, 2026 the board approved a 640-tonne-per-year ultra-fine metal powder materials project at subsidiary Jiangsu Guangyu Energy Storage Materials, planned investment about RMB 1.2 hundred million; on July 21 / August 7, 2026 the board and shareholders approved three more projects - a nano nickel powder fine-grading expansion, a 200nm-and-below nickel powder fine-grading expansion and a 600-tonne-per-year ultra-fine metal powder materials project - with planned total investment of about RMB 2.015 hundred million. In H1 2026 several new nickel-based lines were completed; powder-making equipment RMB 60,717,664.39 and grading equipment RMB 74,342,305.06 were transferred from construction in progress to fixed assets; construction in progress was RMB 125,618,865.04 at June 30, 2026, including the No. 3 workshop and auxiliary buildings at RMB 65,298,357.19.
